name: Dotted Chart
author: Promenade Team
description: A dotted chart of events over time: rows by case, activity, resource or object type; color by any of those; actual, relative or logical time; sortable rows. Ships as a worked example of the sandboxed third-party view boundary: opaque origin, no host DOM, no storage, data only through promenade.sql().

rowsBy.title: Rows
rowsBy.description: What each horizontal line represents. For OCEL logs, selecting an Object case notion below makes each object of that type a row; otherwise object types are aggregate rows.

objectType.title: Object case notion (OCEL)
objectType.description: Each object of this type becomes one dotted-chart row. The most frequent object type is selected automatically for a new view.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT object_type AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {object} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

timeMode.title: Time axis
timeMode.description: Actual: real timestamps. Relative: time since each row's own first event, so every row starts at zero. Logical: plain event order, ignoring real durations.

sampleLimit.title: Max points
sampleLimit.description: Sampling keeps the canvas responsive on large logs.

timeStart.title: Time range
timeStart.description: Limits displayed events before sampling. Drag either handle or reset to the full log range.

dotSize.title: Dot size
dotSize.description: Diameter in screen pixels. Smaller dots make dense timelines easier to read.

showCaseIds.title: Show row IDs
showCaseIds.description: Reserves a left label column for case or object rows. Dense logs show a sampled set, including the first and last sorted row, with vertical ellipses for omitted rows.

showHover.title: Hover event details
showHover.description: Show the nearest event's case, activity, and timestamp under the pointer. Off by default for dense charts.
